newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jardine Fleming launches Thai guaranteed trust.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming launches Thai guaranteed trust.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Unit Trusts said on Friday it launched the JF Thailand Capital Guaranteed Trust.

The new fund will provide investors with an enhanced return of 120 percent, based on the quarterly average increase in the SET 50 index, measured in U.S. dollars if the Thai stock market rises during the fund's two year term.
Investors also have guaranteed return of 95 percent of capital, minus the preliminary charge, if the market falls.
